desc: A favorite for generations, Betty Crocker makes it easy to bring this classic combination of real cheese and sliced potatoes to your family table. These potatoes cooked in a creamy seasoned sauce create an ideal side dish for family meals. Easy to prepare, add boiling water, milk, and butter following the simple steps on the package. With four servings in this 4-ounce box, keep Betty Crocker Scalloped Casserole Potatoes on hand as a convenient part of a weeknight dinner or your Sunday brunch spread. Or stock up and serve Betty Crocker potatoes at your next party or event. Hungry for more ways to meal prep using our potatoes? Look to Betty Crocker recipes for tasty inspiration. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been bringing families easy, delicious recipes. The Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing convenient, tasty dessert mixes, frostings, and convenient meal options and side dishes. Contains one cardboard carton of Betty Crocker Scalloped Casserole Potatoes, Made with Real Cheese, 4 oz Box.

prep:
Stove-Top Directions

1 stir STIR Sauce Mix, 1 1/2 cups hot water, 2/3 cup milk, 2 tablespoons butter and Potatoes in 2-quart saucepan. Heat just to boiling, stirring occasionally.

Watch carefully to avoid boilover.

2 reduce REDUCE heat. Cover; simmer about 25 minutes, stirring often, until tender (sauce will thicken).

YOU WILL NEED:

1 1/2 Cups Boiling Water

2/3 Cup Milk

2 Tablespoons Butter

Oven Directions

1 heat HEAT oven to 425°F. Stir Sauce Mix, boiling water, milk and butter with whisk in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Stir in Potatoes.

2 bake BAKE uncovered about 35 minutes or until top is golden brown and potatoes are tender (sauce will thicken).

BAKING TIPS:

For 2 boxes, double all ingredients; bake in 3-quart casserole dish about 40 minutes at 425°F.

Bake potatoes and roast meat at same time:

325°F about 60 minutes

350°F about 50 minutes

375°F about 45 minutes

Microwave Directions

1 stir STIR Sauce Mix, 2 cups hot water, 2/3 cup milk, 2 tablespoons butter and Potatoes in 2 1/2-quart microwavable casserole dish.

2 microwave MICROWAVE uncovered on High 18 to 23 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until tender (sauce will thicken). CAUTION: HOT!

Make It Like Betty

Stir 1/2 teaspoon onion powder into potato mixture before baking. Top baked Scalloped Potatoes with 1 cup crispy fried onions and 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley before serving.
